The '''''Praetorian''-class frigate''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] manufactured by [[Rendili Hyperworks/Legends|Rendili Hyperworks]] for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="kotorcg" />

==Characteristics==
The ''Praetorian''-class frigate was a 180-meter long capital ship, durable and powerful for its size. Its weapons were geared toward defensive fire, leading to heavy use of the class in an escort role. It carried 12 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and had a standard class two [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="kotorcg" />

==History==
[[File:PraetorianGuardsQuartermaster-KOTORCG-101.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Three ''Praetorian''-class frigates monitor the flight of a [[Quartermaster-class supply carrier|''Quartermaster''-class supply carrier]].]]

The ''Praetorian''-class was first used during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and served at the [[Battle of Koros Major]]. During the galactic reconstruction efforts after the war, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] authorized the sale of the ships to private organizations and planetary governments. Thereafter, they served primarily in an escort role, defending convoys and relief missions against [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks.<ref name="kotorcg" />

The ''Praetorian''-class was the predecessor of the larger [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]].<ref name="kotorcg" /> Eventually, Rendili Hyperworks sold the design to the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], which retooled the hull into the [[Class VI bulk freighter]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> which continued to serve as late as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="cb">{{CasusBelliCite|89|La Nouvelle République : Une autre époque pour Star Wars}}</ref>
A similar design, the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]], saw service in the Republic Navy during the [[Great Galactic War]] and produced by [[Corellia StarDrive]].<ref name="TMBIB">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The visual design of the Class VI freighter originated in the French magazine ''[[Casus Belli 89]]'' illustrated by [[Fred Blanchard]]<ref name="cb" /> who later illustrated the [[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|''Heir to the Empire'']] comic adaptation and inserted a ship of the same visual profile into a scene.<ref name="htte3">[[Heir to the Empire 3|''Heir to the Empire'' 3]]</ref> That illustration later provided the basis for capital ships at the Battle of Koros Major illustrated by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> This created a disparity in the known roles of the design.

This was resolved in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', which explained that the warship was the ''Praetorian''-class frigate and was developed into the later [[Class VI bulk freighter|Class VI freighter]].<ref name="kotorcg" />

A visually similar vessel later made a cameo in the [[Star Wars: Rebellion (comic series)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] comics, though it is now unclear whether it was the warship or the freighter.<ref name="reb2">[[Rebellion 2|''Rebellion'' 2]]</ref>
